text.description_html:
Custom Don-Jo 2-1/2" x 8" Aluminum Plate

Made of .050" thick aluminum. Brushed aluminum with clear anodizing finish. Packaged with mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of Don-Jo 2 1/2 x 8 Aluminum Push Plate

  • Plate Height: 8"
  • Plate Width: 2-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Brushed Aluminum with Clear Anodizing
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

    • *Sold Individually.
